title: Decision
description: A resolved discussion. Captures what was concluded, why, and by whom.

id.description: Globally unique slug identifier using lowercase kebab-case.

title.description: A concise statement of what was decided.

resolves.description: ID of the Discussion this decision closes.

informed_by.description: IDs of Hypotheses, Experiments, or Observations that informed this decision.

created.description: ISO 8601 date when this decision was proposed.

decided_by.description: GitHub username of the maintainer who accepted or rejected this decision.

superseded_by.description: ID of the Decision that replaces this one (used when status is 'superseded').

tags.description: Free-form labels for discovery and filtering.
